'''2001 Ben Con tournament (9 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local (convention) held at Ben Con, Holiday Inn, Denver, CO on 9 June 2001. [[Chris Fanchi]] won it. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2495">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-trd2495/ ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-tr], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 21 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-21-ben-con-denver-co-6-9-01-gooood-trd2495/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Ben Con, Holiday Inn, Denver, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Fanchi]]
